purpose: Initial universe freeze for product due diligence. It identifies every named product and every unnamed allocation category in the legacy reference design; it is not a portfolio, investment recommendation, suitability conclusion, or execution instruction.

global_investability_boundary.rule: No named product may be selected, assigned a target price, used to support the cash objective, or treated as an implementation candidate until its required R0-R4 research artifacts and the portfolio-level return, risk, suitability, account and current-session market gates are independently passed.

status_definitions.active_research_universe_watch_only: A named object explicitly used as a reference anchor or public-REIT candidate in the legacy strategy. It must be fully researched but is not eligible for allocation.
status_definitions.conditional_research_candidate_watch_onl: A named object mentioned only as a secondary or contingent candidate. It must be fully researched if retained; it has no approved allocation role.
status_definitions.unnamed_category_not_researchable: A legacy allocation category without a product identity. It cannot be diligenced, valued, or selected until a finite candidate list is frozen.

unnamed_categories.legacy_role: Current fallback destination and post-approval liquidity reserve; it is not an assumed return source.
required_evidence_modules: freeze the exact bank deposit, direct sovereign instrument or finite candidate list before any product research begins
issuer or sovereign identity, legal claim, deposit-insurance aggregation where applicable and counterparty review
maturity, withdrawal or redemption, settlement, available-cash and forced-sale constraints
rate, fee, tax and net-cash treatment; no assumed yield

unnamed_categories.no_investability_boundary: This is a category, not an identified product. It cannot be labelled eligible, used as a benchmark or treated as protected until a specific arrangement and account facts are independently verified.

unnamed_categories.name: Defensive diversifier
unnamed_categories.legacy_role: Diversification only; it has no cash-target repair role.
required_evidence_modules: approve non-leveraged selection criteria and freeze a finite named candidate universe before product research begins
for each named candidate, collect current legal documents, mandate, price or reference, liquidity, tax, settlement and capacity evidence
calculate candidate-specific common stress, drawdown, correlation and common-driver overlap against the Treasury ETF, dividend ETF and REIT candidates
verify a zero cash-budget assumption and confirm that the product is not a yield-repair substitute
complete product-level valuation or risk-method fit, peer comparison, catalysts, risks and invalidation
unnamed_categories.no_investability_boundary: No generic stress input, placeholder allocation or implied cash yield is permitted. Until a named product independently passes research and portfolio gates, this category remains q=0.

portfolio_selection_constraints.public_reit_requirement: A final public-REIT sleeve requires at least five independently eligible projects, at least three manager or sponsor groups and at least three operating cash-flow sectors.
portfolio_selection_constraints.selection_rule: Passing an individual product note is necessary but not sufficient. The master allocation case must still pass dated portfolio return evidence, risk budget, suitability, account and current-session market gates.

intake_evidence_boundary: This file records the scope only. Existing strategy-case distribution notices, annual reports and product disclosures are not treated as a completed R0 evidence review, a current market packet, a valuation conclusion or an investability decision in this due-diligence case.
